seoTitle: AWS VPC Lab | Built By Raza
seoDescription: A production-style AWS VPC lab covering subnet design, routing, NAT, security and multi-AZ architecture.

hero.heading: Production-Style AWS VPC
hero.introduction: Designing a resilient AWS VPC with public and private subnets, controlled Internet access and a multi-AZ architecture.

paragraphs.text: The goal of this lab is to build a production-style AWS network rather than a single flat VPC.
The design will use multiple Availability Zones, separate public and private subnets, controlled Internet access, routing and security policies.

items.title: VPC & IP Plan
items.description: Define CIDR space and subnet allocation for the environment.

items.title: Multi-AZ Subnets
items.description: Deploy public and private subnets across multiple Availability Zones.

items.title: Routing
items.description: Build route tables for public and private traffic flows.

items.title: Internet Access
items.description: Use an Internet Gateway and NAT architecture for controlled access.

items.title: Security
items.description: Compare Security Groups and Network ACL behavior.

items.title: Failure Testing
items.description: Test what happens when components or paths become unavailable.

paragraphs.text: This section will document the reasoning behind subnet placement, routing, Internet access and high-availability decisions.
The goal is not just to show what was configured, but why the architecture was built that way.
This section will be updated after the lab is complete with troubleshooting notes, unexpected behavior and design improvements.
